summary: All ten followUps.* keys are in the TranslationKey union and in both dictionaries, and every string matches the task-01 table exactly in both languages. whyPrefix ends with exactly one space ('After: ' / 'После: ', checked with cat -A), noticeCreated contains literal {group} and {count} in both languages, the quotes are "" in English and «» in Russian, the new keys sit in one trailing block after notes.* in the existing layout, src/i18n/index.ts is unchanged, and npx tsc --noEmit passes. The one note: the task table's Russian toBacklogHint wording ('Будет заведена…', agreeing with an implied 'задача') differs from the state the user-spec quotes for the item ('будет заведён при сохранении', agreeing with 'пункт'). The code faithfully follows the task, so this is a spec-alignment question, not a coding error.

findings.issue: followUps.toBacklogHint is 'Будет заведена в бэклог при сохранении'. The user-spec quotes the marked state twice (Scenario 4, line 63; the 'Блок «После выполнения»' section, line 87) as «будет заведён при сохранении», in the masculine, agreeing with 'пункт'. The task-01 table introduced the feminine form, implying 'задача', and added 'в бэклог'. The task says 'Wording is fixed by the user-spec where it quotes UI text'. I am not sure the user-spec phrase was meant as literal UI copy rather than a description of the state, but read literally the two disagree. Both wordings are grammatical and understandable. The English 'Will be created in the backlog on save' is fine either way.
findings.recommendation: Pick one wording and record it. Either change the ru value to 'Будет заведён в бэклог при сохранении' (or exactly 'Будет заведён при сохранении') so it agrees with 'пункт' as the user-spec says, or keep the task wording and note the deliberate deviation in 0012-feat-follow-up-tasks-decisions.md, so Task 05 (which renders this hint) and manual QA don't flag it later.
